front.title: The ipn.arpa Zone and IPN DNS Operations

abstract.t: This document requests the creation of ipn.arpa, an infrastructure DNS namespace for the IPN node identifiers of the Bundle Protocol (BP). Each Fully Qualified Node Number has a DNS base name of the form N.A.ipn.arpa, where A is the Allocator Identifier and N is the Node Number. A BP Agent can query beneath that name for the records that a convergence-layer discovery binding specifies, such as SRV or SVCB records. These records identify the convergence-layer endpoints, including relays, that are advertised for reaching a destination.
